      How this works

      You drop paperwork in. It reads each file, turns it into either a cash movement or a promise of one, matches the two together, and works out what that means for the months ahead. Nothing is paid, sent or filed on your behalf — every figure can be edited and every match undone.

      Add an entry

      Settings

      Removes every transaction, document and setting stored in this browser. There is no undo.
